metadata.name: Job Description
metadata.value:
The Executive Recruiter will be responsible for owning and executing executive level searches. This person will need to be well-versed in the full life cycle executive search process (including candidate generation and development, senior client management and offer/negotiation.)

The role will include the following responsibilities:
Oversee the management and execution of full-life cycle executive searches by developing the sourcing and recruiting strategies across select/designated functional areas
Calibrating candidates with hiring managers
Developing those prospects into candidates, engaging them and performing initial assessment (Pitch Calls)
Participating in client update meetings on active searches and preparing reports
Conducting on-site interviews and participating in debriefs; performing reference checks and creatively negotiating complex executive compensation packages.
Support the Senior Director, Executive Recruiting on searches
Develop search strategies, conduct research, and present qualified candidates for executive searches

Required Experience and Education
6+ years of experience within Executive Recruiting
3+ years of leading VP+ level searches
1+ years of project management experience; the ability to follow-through on individual and team-wide goals, plans and projects.
1+ years experience building, and executing, strategies for staffing projects.
1+ years of experience pulling insights from data, and utilizing insights to advise hiring leaders, and influence business decisions.
 
Preferred Experience and Education
Experience in agency and in-house recruiting 
Experience recruiting at a startup and/or within the healthcare industry.
Experience building workforce forecasts
Experience partnering with staffing partners/vendors

Become the expert on your team's business and technical domains

Lead the planning, execution and release of complex technical projects

Work with partners, product managers, and designers to solve challenging problems

Position Summary:
The Staff Software Engineer leads technical efforts to build reliable and maintainable applications, infrastructure, and interfaces that make interacting with the health care system easier for both members and providers.

Primary Duties and Responsibilities
Serve as  the subject matter expert on business and technical domains.
Lead the planning, execution and release of complex technical projects across multiple teams, including owning medium to large features or infrastructure projects from technical design through completion
Work with partners, product managers, and designers to solve challenging problems.
Lead and mentor engineers and engineering teams to improve technology, apply best practices and set overall team direction.
Responsible for ensuring the team’s delivery of  large or complex technology capabilities (set of components or services) within their team's domain or spanning multiple domains.
Facilitate, encourage, and enhance a culture of collaboration within the engineering team and its internal customers; recognizing when cross-team projects are at risk and actively mitigate risk to deliver on time.
Prolific contributor to the objectives of their functional group, and plays a key role in driving outcomes for organization-wide projects.
Work with leadership to assign prioritization of technical roadmap and influence prioritization of product roadmap and process enhancements within their area and across related areas.
Actively identifies and reduces failure domains while working with their team to do the same.
Builds software to minimize effort and business impact during maintenance and failures.
Guide the development of Service-Level Objectives (SLOs) for systems they and their team are responsible for.
